items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: Rufus Reid and I have played off and on together for years. It’s got to be close to 40 years now that we’ve known each other.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I learned, Rufus Reid and I have played off and on together for years. It’s got to be close to 40 years now that we’ve known each other. And the first time I played with Rufus — because when you first meet him he’s a pretty intimidating guy. A big guy with a low voice who speaks slowly. Look out. And I went to the hi-hat behind his solo. And he looked at me and man it was like Mount Vesuvius had erupted. He says, “Don’t do that, treat me like a horn player dammit.” And that was it. Back to the ride…
there are still times when I’ll approach the bass solo like that but the bass player will say, “Hey man, I’d really like it if you’d just go to the hi-hat.” So again —
